summary: Monster Beverage Corporation filed an 8-K reporting its annual meeting results and a new $500M share repurchase authorization. The Board authorized an additional $500M buyback on May 14, 2026, supplementing the ~$400M remaining from the prior program. Repurchases may occur in open-market or negotiated transactions. No price, premium, or expiration date were specified. There is no independent advisor or premium disclosed, signaling ordinary-course capital allocation. The filing also includes uncontested director elections and routine advisory votes. Watch for the pace of repurchases as a signal of management's view on intrinsic value; no risk-arb angle as this is a straight buyback, not an issuer tender.
